description: Implementation of HookReadPlatformService for retrieving hook data, templates, and configurations in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: HookReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing hook data retrieval logic, including fetching all hooks, specific hooks, hooks by event, and hook templates.

classes.name: HookMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to HookData objects.

classes.name: HookEventMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to Event objects.

classes.name: HookConfigMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to Field configuration objects.

classes.name: TemplateMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to HookTemplateData objects.

classes.name: TemplateSchemaMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to schema Field objects within templates.

methods.name: retrieveAllHooks
methods.description: Fetches all hooks from the database.

methods.name: retrieveHook
methods.description: Fetches a specific hook by ID.

methods.name: retrieveHooksByEvent
methods.description: Retrieves hooks listening to a specific event, cached for performance.

methods.name: retrieveNewHookDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details for creating a new hook, optionally filtered by template name.

methods.name: getTemplateForEvents
methods.description: Fetches available event templates for hooks.
